description_ru: Комичная детективная история о семейном торте и маленьких уликах.
text:
Last Sunday, my mother made a big chocolate cake for the family dinner. She put it on the kitchen table and went to the shop for milk.

When she came back, half of the cake was gone. My mother looked at my brother, Sam. "Did you eat the cake?" she asked. "No," said Sam. "I was in my room all the time."

My mother looked at his face. There was chocolate on his nose, on his chin and even in his hair. "Then who is this?" she asked, and she pointed at a photo on her phone. In the picture, Sam was smiling happily with a fork in his hand.

"Oh," said Sam. "I forgot about the camera in the kitchen."

Now Sam has to wash the dishes for a week. He is still sad, but I am quite happy. I got the last piece of the cake, and nobody saw me.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: p, t, k в начале слова произносите с лёгким придыханием, как будто выдыхаете «х».
Поставьте кончик языка между зубами и выдохните без голоса; не заменяйте звук на «с» или «ф».
Округлите губы, как для «у», и быстро переходите к гласному; зубов не касайтесь.
Не оглушайте звонкий согласный в конце слова: в «bed», «dog» звучит d, g, а не т, к.

questions.question: How did the mother know?
questions.answer: She saw a photo from the camera.

questions.question: What must Sam do for a week?
